issue.title: Simplify nightly schedule: one cron + Slack on build complete
issue.body:
## Problem

Nightly Preview looks unreliable / double-running, and Slack lands at the wrong time for QA.

**Observed (Sep 2026):**

| What | Intended | Actual |
| --- | --- | --- |
| APK cron `17 23 * * *` America/Los_Angeles | ~23:17 PT | Lands ~**04:30 PT** / **05:30 MT** (~5h GitHub delay) |
| Slack cron `7 9 * * *` America/Los_Angeles | ~09:07 PT | Lands ~**12:15 PT** / **13:15 MT** (~3h delay) |
| Actions UI | 1 useful run/day | **2 schedule fires/day** (APK + Slack-only) |
| EAS `nightly` profile | — | **1 APK/day** (no duplicate EAS builds) |

Confirmed via Actions history + Expo EAS `build_list` for project `b0919574-f268-4768-b3bd-7cfa5172bbab`.

The dual-cron design (hold Slack until Pacific business hours via pending artifact + morning delivery job) was added in #421 / fixed for delayed APK in #459. Incoming webhooks cannot mute phone push, which motivated the hold — but the second cron + delay window now produces midday Slack and confusing double runs. Timing also does not align with India morning QA (~09:00 IST ≈ previous-day evening Mountain).

## Proposed direction (simplify)

Prefer a thinner design over more window/cron logic:

1. **One** schedule cron (re-register thoughtfully — GitHub delay is expected).
2. **Slack immediately** when the APK job finishes (success / skip / quiet no-APK), during that same run.
3. Remove the morning Slack-only cron, pending artifact upload, and `deliver-pending-slack-nightly.sh` path (or leave scripts unused until deleted).
4. Pick a target wall-clock that matches when offshore QA should see the notice (confirm desired local time: e.g. late evening Mountain / early India morning — account for ~3–5h GitHub delay when choosing the cron).
5. Update docs (`docs/ci.md`, QA guides, `.github/README.md`, handoff copy).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Single scheduled trigger for Nightly Preview (no Slack-only second cron)
- [ ] At most one EAS `nightly` build attempt per successful schedule fire (unchanged skip-if-unchanged behavior)
- [ ] Slack posts in the same workflow run as the build/skip outcome (no pending-artifact morning delivery)
- [ ] Cron + docs state the intended local time and that GitHub may delay hours
- [ ] Unit/docs tests updated for removed windows / delivery path
- [ ] No overnight Slack requirement unless product re-asks for quiet-hours hold

## Out of scope

- Changing EAS profiles or Slack webhook secrets
iOS
- Implementing until explicitly picked up (ticket only for now)

## Related

- #421 — dual cron + Pacific Slack hold
- #459 / #462 — trust delayed APK cron identity
